annotations.title: Get closing line value of a price

description:
Closing line value (CLV) of one price against a sports or esports market's stored close, the close get_market_close serves. Send the market, the outcome and either a Polymarket price (0 to 1) or sportsbook odds with their format. status is measured with the figures; in_play when placed_at is at or after kickoff (a pre-game close says nothing about an in-play bet); pending when no close is stored yet; or unavailable with unavailable_reason, including anchor_stale when kickoff moved after the close was captured. A missing close is null, never 0. clv.points is the close probability minus the entry's break-even probability, in percentage points; clv.price_pct is the entry's decimal odds over the close's, minus 1, in percent; clv.ev_at_close_pct is the expected return per unit staked if the close was fair, in percent, and equals price_pct against a Polymarket close; clv.cents is set for a price entry only, the close minus the price paid. A sell is measured as the buy of the other outcome. Figures are gross of fees.

Args:
  - condition_id (string, required): Raw provider condition_id or the mkt_-prefixed market id
  - outcome (integer, required): 0 (the first, YES outcome) or 1 (the second)
  - price (number, optional): Polymarket price paid, or received with side sell
  - odds (string, optional): sportsbook odds, such as +130 or 2.30
  - format (string, optional): american or decimal, required with odds
  - side (string, optional): buy (default) or sell
  - placed_at (string, optional): RFC3339 time the bet was placed

Returns: condition_id, status, unavailable_reason, outcome, outcomes, side, entry (price, from_odds, format, decimal_odds, placed_at), close (status, unavailable_reason, price, game_start_time, close_anchor_at, anchor_stale, observed_at, source), clv (cents, points, price_pct, ev_at_close_pct), basis_version and meta.

condition_id.description: Raw provider condition_id or the mkt_-prefixed market id

format.description: How odds is written; required with odds

odds.description: Sportsbook odds for the outcome, such as +130 or -140 (american) or 2.30 (decimal). Needs format; send price or odds, not both

outcome.description: The outcome the entry is on: 0 is the first (YES) outcome, 1 the second (NO)

placed_at.description: RFC3339 time the bet was placed. At or after kickoff answers status in_play with no figures; omitted, the bet is read as placed before kickoff

price.description: A Polymarket price paid (or received, with side sell), 0 to 1, such as 0.455. Send price or odds, not both

side.description: buy (default) or sell. A sell is a Polymarket price received and is measured as the buy of the other outcome; sportsbook odds are always a buy

name: get_clv
title: Get closing line value of a price
